disputes.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer each name exactly one potentially missable trophy: Positive Mental Attitude, whose first meditation is a one-time Chapter 1 moment.
disputes.b: PlanetGTA6, writing three days after launch, says there is no reliable missable list yet and declines to name any.
disputes.verdict: Protect Positive Mental Attitude as if it were the only missable, because the cost of doing so is two minutes in Chapter 1. Everything else can be verified later; that meditation cannot.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer put the platinum at roughly 200 hours with a 4/10 difficulty rating.
disputes.b: Push Square warns the full clear could run to 300 hours or more.
disputes.topic: How long is the platinum, really?
disputes.verdict: Plan around 200 hours of engaged play. The checklist is only about 60% of the game's true content, but exploration travel time is what pushes slow runs toward Push Square's figure.

disputes.a: The 100% checklist as printed by PowerPyx and Shacknews asks you to scan 200 of 277 base model vehicles.
disputes.b: One PowerPyx summary elsewhere cites 557 vehicles in the game's full vehicle pool.
disputes.topic: How many vehicles must be scanned for 100%?
disputes.verdict: Trust the in-game checklist counter: 200 of the 277 base models it tracks. The larger figure counts every vehicle variant in the game, most of which the checklist ignores.

disputes.a: The trophy description for Positive Mental Attitude says meditate at every spot: all 18.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist only requires 15 of the 18 meditation spots.
disputes.verdict: Do all 18. The checklist's 15 is a floor for completion percentage; the trophy is only satisfied at 18, and the spots are quick once found.

disputes.a: Cunning Stunts pops at 250 completed stunts.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist requires 300 of the 397 stunts that exist.
disputes.topic: Stunts: stop at 250 or push to 300?
disputes.verdict: Push to 300 in the same grind. Splitting it into two grinds wastes the routes you learned reaching 250.

disputes.a: One Last Thing pops at 50 completed challenges.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist requires 70 of the 80 challenges.
disputes.verdict: Aim for 70 from the start, choosing the easiest challenges first. Both targets let you skip the ten hardest, so there is no reason to touch them.

disputes.a: Don't Touch My Deck pops at just 3 completed card sets.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist requires 15 of the 18 sets.
disputes.verdict: Never treat 3 as the goal. Collect cards in every interior from the first hour so the 15-set requirement fills passively instead of becoming an endgame sweep.

disputes.a: SixShore notes PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which stranger strands qualify for Strangers & Freaks.
disputes.b: GTABase's roadmap treats the named character lines as the reliable path to the eight strands.
disputes.topic: Which 8 strands count for Strangers & Freaks?
disputes.verdict: Finish all six named character lines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and then complete any two further strands in full. A strand only counts when finished, so do not leave lines hanging.

disputes.a: TrueTrophies and the official list in this kit count 28 hidden trophies.
disputes.b: SixShore notes Push Square marks 27 hidden.
disputes.topic: How many trophies are hidden: 27 or 28?
disputes.verdict: Use 28, matching the official PlayStation list this guide is built from: the 12 story trophies, the 5 character-line finales, and 11 hidden free-roam moments.

disputes.a: Earn Cash, Not Kudos pops at 20 different race wins.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist wants 30 unique races won and 10 race challenge gold medals on top.
disputes.verdict: Race widely from the start and bank 30 unique wins. Repeating one easy race is the trap this trophy pair sets.

roadmap.goal: Protect the run's only missable and bank the first story trophies.
roadmap.title: Chapter 1, and the one missable
work: Play Gone Fishing and the Chapter 1 missions in order; both early story trophies pop on their own.
After Down to Earth, go to Jason's house in the morning, accept Lucia's invitation, and complete the balcony meditation before the chapter closes.
Start scanning with the WAiNK app whenever it prompts: scans made now count later.

roadmap.goal: Open every system the cleanup stages depend on.
roadmap.title: Chapters 2 to 4: open the map, start the habits
work: Finish Chapters 2, 3 and 4 and the named story missions (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory).
Sample each of the nine activity types once for Master of None as they unlock.
In Chapter 4, play the optional mission that introduces bank jobs; vault robberies depend on it.
Keep a light robbery rotation between missions so fencing totals grow from early on.

roadmap.goal: Roll the credits and unlock the real game board: the 100% checklist.
roadmap.title: Chapter 5 and the finale
work: Complete Chapter 5 and the final mission for the story gold.
After the credits, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and pin the checklist as your tracker for the rest of the run.
Confirm the balcony meditation is banked; if it is, nothing left on the list can be permanently missed.

roadmap.goal: Clear the Story and Tasks block of the checklist.
roadmap.title: The robbery economy
work: Clear all 39 gang operations, tagging one robbery for each of the nine gangs early for Pest Control.
Run all 22 bank jobs and 7 payday loan jobs; hit all 8 vaults (Maximum Withdrawal pops at 5).
Fence up to the totals: $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 marked bills for Dime on the Dollar, $200,000 vehicles.
Rob an armored truck, stealth one jewelry store, and spend through $100,000 in shops; buy the 8 garages as the fund allows.

roadmap.goal: Convert skill into the activity trophies and checklist lines.
roadmap.title: Skill, speed and stunts
work: Gold all 42 shooting range challenges across Griffin and Rodgers Ranch for The Shootist.
Win the Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations and bank 30 unique race wins.
Ride stunts up to 300 of 397 (Cunning Stunts pops at 250) and complete 70 of 80 challenges.
Sweep the one-off moments: Combat Focus five-for-one, the VCIA departure, the Rhino, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom exit, bowling, and the two partner wanted-level trophies.

roadmap.goal: Fill the Exploration and Discovery blocks of the checklist.
roadmap.title: Collectibles and discovery
work: Complete 15 of 18 card sets (Don't Touch My Deck pops at 3) and scan 100 WAiNK locations for You WAiNKer!.
Find all 33 underwater discoveries, 30 magazines/books/comics and 100 cocaine flamingos; finish the remaining meditation spots to 18.
Scan 200 base model vehicles (Whip It Good pops at 100), find 50 weapons, study 100 animals through binoculars.
Register 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app and visit any map areas still unvisited to reach all 52.

roadmap.goal: Close every character line and let the last two trophies fall.
roadmap.title: Strangers, cleanup, platinum
work: Finish the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus Bret's unique-animal hunt and his Target Decks.
Count completed strands: at eight, Strangers & Freaks pops.
Mop up any single missing trophy from the checklist view, watch A Long Road complete, and the platinum, Vice Got a Price!, follows automatically.

watchlist.action: Find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, accept her invitation, and meditate on the balcony before you finish the chapter.
watchlist.window: Chapter 1 only, after the mission Down to Earth. The moment does not return.

watchlist.action: Close the named character lines before the finale as a safety habit, and never leave a strand half-finished.
watchlist.trophyName: Strangers & Freaks + the six character lines
watchlist.window: Character quests are safest finished before the final mission; some side quests carry an hourglass and expire, though those do not count toward trophies.

watchlist.action: Play as Lucia for Andy's strand and as Jason for Tyrone's (and Bret's) strand; switch protagonists if the icons stop appearing.
watchlist.trophyName: Road to Rehabilitation / Spin On This!
watchlist.window: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and Tyrone's are Jason-only, which reads as a missable if you play the wrong protagonist.

watchlist.action: Keep your criminal profile below Irredeemable for the whole run; the guides flag it as permanent once set.
watchlist.window: The Irredeemable criminal profile cannot be undone once earned.

watchlist.action: Never activate a cheat on your platinum save file; if you experiment, do it in a throwaway session.
watchlist.window: Cheats switch trophies off for that game session and block saving.
